_comment: Example ONLY. The real file lives at ~/.config/agent2telegram/config.json, is written
0600 by `python3 -m agent2telegram setup`, contains your bot token, and must never be
mode           'attach' drives an existing live tmux session (required for Remote Control)
tmux_session   the persistent seat both you and Telegram drive
origin_prefix  injected before every Telegram-originated prompt; this is what tells the
Remote Control hook that a turn is NOT terminal-originated, so it is never
transcript_path 'auto' resolves the session's own transcript, scoped by working directory
signal_file    where the Stop hook signals turn end; its parent is the state directory
token          from @BotFather — or leave it out and export TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN instead
allowed_user_ids  numeric Telegram user ids allowed to drive the agent. Keep this tight:
anyone on the list can run code on this machine. 123456789 below is a
placeholder — send /id to your bot to learn your real one.
